description: Python class for managing mpv media player via IPC, including starting the process, sending commands, and controlling playback properties.

classes.name: IPC_MPV
classes.description: Class for managing mpv through Inter Process Communication (IPC), providing methods to control playback, properties, and process management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes IPC_MPV instance, sets socket path, and starts mpv process.

methods.name: init_mpv
methods.description: Starts the mpv process with specified command-line arguments.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a JSON command to the mpv IPC server and returns the response data.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the media.

methods.name: wait_until_playing
methods.description: Placeholder for waiting until media is playing.

methods.name: screenshot_to_file
methods.description: Takes a screenshot and saves to a file.
